messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — VeraThera sent their security questionnaire and wants answers before tomorrow's onboarding call (11am PT). Main asks: SOC2 copy, DPA language around embeddings retention, KMS key ownership (BYOK?), and subprocessor list. Who can take these pieces?

Arjun Patel: I can grab the SOC2 report and extract the relevant pages. Quick clarifying q: is this for their production workspace on hosted Redwood or are they evaluating Dedicated/private?

Maya Chen: Hosted for now (they said 'prod on Redwood-hosted'). They explicitly asked whether we support customer-managed keys for hosted and exact retention for embeddings.

Evan Brooks: For hosted we do not support per-customer BYOK. We manage encryption keys for hosted; Dedicated/Private supports customer KMS/HSM. I can write a short note explaining the difference and include our KMS integration doc + key rotation policy.

Sophie Li: I can draft the DPA answers: retention, deletion process, and subprocessor list. Current subproc list includes AWS (S3/RDS), GCP (analytics pipeline), Datadog (metrics), Sentry (errors), Posthog (product analytics). I'll inline the short justification for each.

LegalBot: Recommended template: `DPA_ANSWERS_TEMPLATE_v1.2.docx`. Use the SOC2 excerpt redaction rules when sharing the report externally.

Arjun Patel: Pulling SOC2 now. Note — the public SOC2 summary is fine to share; the full report is redacted. I'll attach the excerpt showing control descriptions + auditor opinion. Evidence ID: `SOC2-2025-EXCERPT-042` (will paste into the thread).

Evan Brooks: Also flag: VeraThera asked about embeddings retention default — we retain embeddings for 90 days by default on hosted unless the customer requests shorter retention for PII workflows. We'll state default + how to request changes.

Maya Chen: Good. Action items: Arjun — SOC2 excerpt + small snippet about audit scope by EOD. Evan — KMS note + short blurb about Hosted vs Dedicated (for call talking points). Sophie — DPA answers + subproc list. I'll consolidate and send to VeraThera contact after your drops. Anyone object to that plan?

Arjun Patel: No objections. Quick snippet I'll paste into the doc:```SOC2 excerpt: Auditor opinion: "In our opinion, the controls were suitably designed and operated effectively..." (redacted)```

Sophie Li: One more item — they asked about data deletion for embeddings when a tenant deletes data. Our flow: async job queues and garbage collection within 48 hours, with a logged deletion event. I'll add a short diagram link in the DPA answer.

Evan Brooks: Also note a known gap — hosted does not offer per-tenant audit log exports. We can provide org-level audit logs (downloadable) and commit to working with them if they need per-tenant exports (sales/design follow-up). Flagging as a potential renewal risk if they require BYOK/per-tenant logs.

Maya Chen: Good flag — I'll surface that in the call and propose Dedicated as the solution (and surface rough pricing). Sophie, can you include that as a limitation in the DPA language?

Sophie Li: Yep — will include a short limitation section and suggested mitigation (Dedicated or contract clause).

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Plan to send consolidated package to VeraThera contact (alice@verathera.com) by 5pm PT. If you can drop docs earlier that helps. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — onboarding call with VeraThera at 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC (this is a calendar invite).
